tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i dbang chog rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i dbang chog rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i dbang chog rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ a phyi'i byin rlabs gtor dbang dang*/ 'khor lo'i zhal gdams 'di la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin mchod gtor bshams la/ phrin las kyi cho ga gzhung bsrang*/ sta gon la gtor ma a phyir bskyed la/ dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ las bum gcig la sha za mkha' 'gro bskyed/ bzlas pa byas la bzhag slob ma rnams las bum chus khrus byas/ gu gul dkar nag gis bdugs la/ gral du 'khod/ sdom ni/ bgegs skrad srung 'khor maṇḍal dang*// gsol gdab skyabs sems bdun dag bya// lhar bskyed dbang bzhi gtor dbang bskur// bka' bsgo srung skud dam la bzhag /ces so// de la dang po rang bdag bskyed gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis me tog bzung nas/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags drag sngags brjod nas bgegs skrad/ rgyas par spro na rdo rje rgyan can nas bshad pa ltar srung 'khor bsgom/ bsdus par byed na/ rang dang slob ma thams cad kyi 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng du gur dang bla re/ bar du drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ slar yang rdo rje phra mos gtams shing*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bas khyab cing brtan par bsgom/ de nas maṇḍal rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi// sgrib pa ma lus dag bya'i phyir// ma smin smin byed dbang bskur stsol// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod pa yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ ces dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// dge de byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes pa rnams lan gsum gyis skyabs sems dang bdun rnam dag bya/ lhar bskyed pa ni/ slob ma mngon rtogs ltar bsgom du gzhug de'i spyi bor dbang gi mkha' 'gro sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ phyag g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon pa lcags kyu bsnams pa zhig bsgoms/ thugs kar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol bar bsgom/ gsang gnas su sha za mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan par bsgom/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdang sngags phreng bsam/ de nas sku yi dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa dbab pa dang*/ gsung gi dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes dbab pa/ thugs kyi dam tshig bskyed pa dang ye shes dbab pa gsum las/ dang por/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ u rgyan gyi gnas dang rang bzhin dang 'og min nas/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi bdag mdun gyi gtso 'khor thams cad ḍa ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra 'ur 'ur/ sil sil skad cig gis spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la thim/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// slob mas brjod/ yang bla mas/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi/ 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slar yang*/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog de rnams kyi byin rlabs a phyi'i sku la bsdus nas dpag tu med pa spyan drangs slob ma la thim/ bcom ldan zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brjod/

de nas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang*/ bdag mdun las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi srung ma la phog byin rlabs nus pa mkhyen brtse phrin las thams cad gtso mo'i sngags su spyan drangs/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs par bsams te/ gong bzhin brjod/ slar yang*/ bdag mdun thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phog byin rlabs thams cad a phyi'i sngags su gyur nas slob ma la thim/ gong ltar brjod/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul du zhal nas byung*/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar thim zhing 'khor ba la dmigs te/ sngags rnams bzlas/ bcom ldan 'di la dang*/ su pra brjod/ thugs kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa la/ slob ma a phyir gsal ba'i thugs kar/ sa bon dang sngags kyi tha mar dngul dkar gyi me long*/ mda'/ nor bu/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnams kyi bskor bar bsam nas/ bdag mdun thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng phyag mtshan rnams las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi srung ma rnams la phog de rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng sa bon phyag mtshan du byas nas/ rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum phyag mtshan rnams la thim par bsams nas/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// slar yang bdag mdun las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog byin rlabs nus mthu phrin las dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin par thim/ dri ma dag gsang dbang thob/

snying khar thim/ dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/ lus la thim/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag tshig dbang rin po che thob par bsams la/ ngo sprod do/ de nas gtor ma lhar bskyed pa de dngos su bzhugs par bsams la/ slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ ma hrīḥ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis/ ma chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ ye shes kyi dbang gis phrin las dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ ye shes kyi sgron ma/ dam tshig gi sgron ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ pha med rgyud kyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyen po 'di nyid kyi srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams la/ ye shes la gsal 'grib mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ mthu stobs la thogs pa mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma kyai dpal ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yon tan gyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phrin las kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las skyel ma dam pa mdzad du gsol/ yang dag pa'i lam la 'khrid pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sun ma dang 'phrad par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi ltung zhing*/ thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig

lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du zhing*/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med pa bde blag tu stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig a phyi chos kyi sgron ma gtso 'khor bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma/ a mes tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ g.yung drung rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' dbang phyug dpe ka dbang rgyal/ na 'gag pa bsod nams dpal/ ka thung gru bzhi/ mkhan po dar ma/ dkon mchog rin chen/ btsun pa 'bar/ yab rnal 'byor pa rdo rje/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum mgon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rgyal ba gcung*/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po/ chos kyi rgyal po/ don grub rgyal po/ bdag po waṃ rin po che/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ mnyam med dbang rin po che chos kyi rgyal po/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la bar chad sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ srung skud dmar po yum gyi sngags kyis btab pa dpung pa g.yon la btags/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng nas khyod kyi rdo rje slob dpon nga yin pas brnyas par ma byed cig srung ma 'di'i dam tshig

rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang bcas pa srungs shig bye brag tu sgrub pa dang mchod pa/ gtor ma sogs las bzhi'i phrin las la brtson par gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes dang*/ bka' drin btang rag yon du/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /gu ru ratna maṇḍal pū dza ho// a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i dbang chog rin po che'i phreng ba 'di 'dan bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ ā nanda badzra sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas su bkod pa'i dge bas chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig/ ༈ //de ltar rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod drug gi ༄༅/ / grangs ldan 'di nyid/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud gsung rab nyams gso khang nas mthun 'gyur thog sri zhu'i las byed/ bar rta mgon po rdo rje dang*/ yo red brtson 'grus seṅge/ yo red ye shes rgya mtsho/ sga pa karma 'gyur med/ nag chu dkon mchog don grub/ gus 'brong ngur skal bzang chos 'phel bcas nas dad 'dun lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas par skrun gyi bya ba rnams legs par bsgrubs pa'i dge bas lus can 'gro ba mtha' dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/ //
